data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 was GBP 1,249.066m. During calendar year 2014 the Syndicate recorded a release from prior years of approximately GBP 140.4m (net), driven by favourable development on prior catastrophe-related claims (notably reductions in estimates for Hurricane Ike, the Japanese earthquake, Thai floods and Hurricane Sandy) and other favourable claims developments. No gross prior-year movement figure was presented explicitly in the gross 'insurance liabilities' column, so the reported quantified movement is a net release.
raw_causal_phrases: A release of GBP 140.4m from the net reserve for claims outstanding, set at 31 December 2013, has been made in calendar year 2014.
Net reserves for claims outstanding at 31 December 2012 had a release of GBP 115.2m in calendar year 2013.
The old years' release of GBP 2m benefited from reductions in the loss estimates for Hurricane Ike, the Japanese earthquake and Thai floods.
The pure year benefited from a reduction in the loss estimate for Hurricane Sandy.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross opening claim reserves are taken from the Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding = GBP 1,249,066k) with high confidence. The report does not present an explicit gross (insurance liabilities) 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure; only a narrative statement giving a NET release of GBP 140.4m is provided. Per extraction rules, the NET prior-year release has been used as a fallback. No gross claims development triangle or gross prior-year movement table was available to compute a gross PYD. Amounts and allocations to specific events are not quantified in the source and have been inferred where noted; users should treat the prior year movement as NET and view lob allocations as indicative.
